Principle 6: My Weekend
How I Spend Saturday Mornings
Lately, our company does not open on Saturdays, so I have lots of free time.
I use my weekend time to learn new things.
I get up late on Saturday.
Sometimes I help my wife and we usually go to the public baths (spa) to release stress.
I also try to exercise and practice my English.
How I Spend Saturday Afternoons
I joined a soccer team with my company, so I sometimes go play games against other teams.
I have made many friends this way.
Sometimes I go shopping with my family, and we usually pick up everything we need for one week.
How I Spend Sunday Mornings
There are many religions in Korea.
My family is Christian, so we go to church every Sunday.
At church, we always sing songs and listen to the sermon.
The most popular religion is Buddhism.
Koreans who are Buddhist usually don’t go to their temples frequently but only on special occasions a few times a year.
On the other hand, Atheists don’t go to church at all, and they mostly spend their Sundays in many different ways.
How I Spend Sunday Afternoons
On some Sunday afternoons, my friends and I visit each other’s homes,5 and we either go out to eat or just visit.
If we don’t visit with our friends, we usually go to either my family’s or my wife’s family’s house and spend time with them.
